subject: english
question:
Choose the best option to replace the underlined part to improve the given sentence. If no substitution is required, select 'No substitution.'

We met at the restaurant **__at a long time.__**
solution:
The correct answer is '**2**' i.e. **after a long time**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence refers to meeting someone after a considerable gap of time, so the correct preposition to use is "**after**."
 
• The phrase "**after a long time**" correctly conveys the intended meaning of the sentence.
